string.text: There is a place on Zaton where «frying» under water occurred.They call it the Cauldron because steam comes out of the ground there, as if from a real cauldron.If you think that steam is nonsense, you are sorely mistaken.Experienced stalkers say something: such a steam anomaly hits no weaker, and even stronger than the usual «frying».The temperature may be a little lower, but the humidity is!And it bakes longer.And the artifacts found there were ordinary, fiery ones.

They say the quarry is a good place: there are a lot of artifacts.But there are also many anomalies there.At the bottom, the «carbonation» is already gurgling, and even in a gas mask, my eyes are watering.

Ashes is an old cemetery near Kopachi.It's very dangerous there, there's a lot of «frying», sometimes zombies come.Usually this place is bypassed by the tenth road, but sometimes artifacts are found there.

They say that artifacts were found at the old site.There is absolutely nothing of transport there, but even with what there is, there is quite a noise, so the meter goes off scale.Well, there's plenty of «electric» in there too.

In the Rotten Grove - this is where the trees were twisted by the acid.Those who went there said that there are a lot of «sodas» there, and there is so much gas in the air that you can't really see anything - fog!But if you have experience, you can find artifacts there.

If you are looking for artifacts, then acidic ones are better.And the best place to look for them is the «Concrete Bath».There are few competitors there: right next to the Jupiter workshop, so you understand...

Not far from the Jupiter plant, the road collapsed.This place was nicknamed «Bitumen» because the road surface melted there.The gap is full of anomalies: «frying» mixed with gravitational ones... And since there are two types of anomalies there, there must be different artifacts.

There is a place here behind the cement plant, it is also called Plavni.One bay has simply turned into a terrible, smelly swamp - but what do you want when there is a lot of «soda» in the water?There is no longer water there, but almost pure acid... Artifacts were found there, yes, but they also say that monsters really like this place.

You have to look at the old cement plant: there are a lot of anomalies there, but the game is worth the candle.Of course, there are places where it is easier to get an artifact, but where it is easier, there are more competitors.But here only jerboas can bother you, and only if you go into the basements.

You need to look near Sosnodub - this is the same thing that grew between the hills above the soda shops.Everyone here calls it that: some smart guy determined that the bark on that tree is partly pine and partly oak.If you want to look for an artifact there, you need good protection from chemicals... Well, grab more ammunition: dogs are often found on the hills.

Sometimes you don't have to go into an anomaly to find an artifact!They told me a story about how an artifact was found in the middle of an open field.One stalker's detector was malfunctioning, so he decided to change the batteries.I changed it... and then the detector suddenly goes off and an artifact almost flies out into the man's hands!Think about how lucky you are?The zone is like this: sometimes it will punish you, and sometimes it will reward you.

I heard from experienced stalkers that sometimes artifacts move outside anomalies.When the detector starts beeping, you just take it out and there's nothing left."What's happened?"- you think, this stray artifact passed by.What's a shame is that it's useless to chase after him: the Zone itself decides who to reward with such a miracle.
No one has yet looked for artifacts in Pripyat.Everyone I know who is new here... is being careful!
Who knows where to look for them here!Pripyat has been little explored.
I would look in underground tunnels.They say there are a lot of them near the city.

Little is known about these places - mainly what Garik said.He says there is a place here where a huge grape grew out of an acid anomaly, the size of a ten-story building.Maybe he's lying... but if not, I would definitely check this grapevine for artifacts.

The surest thing is to look in a poisonous swamp.There are still a lot of gravity anomalies there, but they are easy to detect: they leave such traces on the water, you can't go wrong.But with soda it's worse, because of them it's practically impossible to breathe there.And how else will it splash on you - it won't seem like much either: it corrodes the armor right before your eyes.

On the burnt out farm, which is on a hill, there is a lot of «hotness».Well, artifacts are often found there - fiery ones, of course.You need to look in houses: they say, in which house more «hots» were formed after the release, the artifact will definitely be found in that house.

There are probably a lot of them in the caves under the burnt out farm.If you walk along a hill with a detector in your hands, it beeps all the time.It's easy to get there: you can jump from above, through the gap.It will be more difficult to get out - there are many, many anomalies!Mainly «funnels» and «soda»... we also saw that something was moving in the fault, sort of like a «comet».This is such a varied set.On the other hand, the artifacts there are probably different.

Have you seen the Circus anomaly?There is a huge «springboard» anomaly, and two comets are circling around it... what a sight!It's just better to admire from afar: towards the center the real heat begins, it's «hot» to hell.There are artifacts there, but a fiery poltergeist is preventing you from looking for them - she's a bastard, you know!As soon as you approach, he immediately tries to fry you!

If you are interested in gravitational artifacts, then you need to look in the «Fang» anomaly.It's hard not to notice this place - the anomalies there have severely distorted the ground, part of the hill was simply completely demolished.And in the caves that opened in the hill, snorks immediately settled, but they rarely go outside.
In the Zone, man, in the Zone!The main thing is not to despair.
Great question.If you find out, tell me, okay?
Where, when... The main thing is this: if you find a «fishy» place, don't tell anyone!
Where can you find artifacts?
I already answered you.
No, I don't know anything else.
That's all I know.Ask others.
Hello, brother.
Greetings.
Hello stalker.
Hello.
What do you need?
What do you want?
Speak.
I wish you good health, Comrade Major!
I wish you good health!
I'm listening to you, Comrade Major.
What good things can you tell me?
How are you?
Well, hello.
What do you want?
Oh, I drew myself!
Oh, stalker!What do you need?
Hayushki.
Hello, man.
Oh, cool, man.
Great.
Hello!
Brother, help!
Brother, save me, I'm dying!..
Need medical help!
First aid kit, quickly!..
First aid kit, give me the first aid kit...
Help me out, man... Ah, blah!It hurts!
Uncle, the pharmacy...give me the pharmacy!..
Dude... ohh... help me out, dude!..
Maine, I need a first aid kit... urgently...
Stalker, help... give me the first aid kit!..
I'm injured... help!
Give me the first aid kit!
First aid kit!

Have you heard about the dredger a little east of Skadovsk?They say there is a strange glow there at night.It's strange even for the Zone.In general, I don't even know... maybe I should climb up there and take a look to see if there's anything valuable?Or maybe, well, him?Don't risk your butt so it's more whole?

Everything here is old!Take, for example, the abandoned convoy on the Preobrazhensky Bridge: everything there, including the bridge, has rusted to hell!But, you know, you still want to rummage around there.If it weren't for mutants and anomalies...

Did you hear that the bastard Sultan wanted to crush the Beard under himself?Not only is his gangster face tolerated at Skadovsk, he also decided to show off!Just attacked the wrong one.They say that Beard and our stalker brethren did this to him... The Sultan will no longer see his former authority among the bastards!

Damn, did you hear?The Sultan, the bastard, ran into Beard!.. I don't know how he did this, but it seems he also put Beard on the counter.How can this even be?!Before you know it, Skadovsk will become a raspberry.

Brother, have you heard about Oasis?They say there is such a place: it is not easy to find it, and even more difficult to get there, even if you know the way.They also say that there is a lake there: you go into it and all illnesses go away... but what's up - any wounds close!Eh, what's the point of chatting in vain... Have you seen how many newcomers have rushed here, to the center of the Zone?Some are looking for Klondike artifacts, some are out of curiosity, but many need the Oasis.He's rumored to be somewhere in these parts.

They say that's it, screw the Zone!Someone found the Oasis and took the main artifact, the «Heart of the Oasis.»Now the Zone will go into another dimension and none of the stalkers will ever get out of it!.. Ha-ha!Joke!Did you believe it?.. No, really, they found some new artifact.Now the scientists in the bunker are working magic on him.

Have you heard about Poplar?He recently found a promising ass for his guys - and, naturally, they went there with a joyful squeal.They got so bad that the inspector picked their brains.It would have been the end for the guys if it weren't for the stalker who was with them.They say that the zombification has left Topol, he blinked his eyes - and in front of him this same stalker is squatting and cutting off the ears from a dead controller as a souvenir.

Have you heard about the village of Kopachi?When there was the first accident at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, it was so covered in radiation that they decided to bury it all up to the roof.All that remains of the houses there now are radioactive mounds.They say the place was creepy back then, but no one really knows what's going on there now.Everyone bypasses them - they are afraid... What if they bypass them in vain?Maybe the Klondike of artifacts is there?

Do you know that now there are only two stalkers on the Yanov who sense the approach of an ejection?One is the Chiropractor, our medic, and the second is the Zulu, a former «long-server».Quite recently I left there.When the Dolgovites arrived at the Yanov station, there were already Svoboda fighters there - and, naturally, the arrival of Dolg did not please them.During the shootout, half of both squads were killed, and several free stalkers also came under attack.It was then that Zulu shouted, «Hide, everyone, the release is coming.»There was nowhere to go, «Duty» and «Svoboda» declared a truce and took refuge at the station.And Zulu almost immediately after that left «Duty» and settled next to the station, on the tower.

Yes, they tell a lot of strange things, but to believe everything is not to respect yourself.Storytellers are scattered like unshot dogs, even though it's a Zone!But what's strange is that several stalkers from the Yanov station have already said that they saw a UFO.They say it looks like a black disk with a diameter of about five meters.Although others say that it looks like an airplane somewhere, that's why no one was particularly alarmed at first.Only the former pilot was among the eyewitnesses, and so he later said that he had never seen anything like it in his entire life.

The only new thing is sad... Good stalkers disappear one after another, and then their bodies are found without a drop of blood.Lyadsky bloodsuckers, and even a whole flock, it's amazing!Eh, I wish I could find a hole in which they are holed up - and I can't stuff them full of lead!No, but what do we have left?Even go to the toilet only in pairs?Yes, here's a free stalker's life for you...

There's a fresh joke.The guys from "Freedom" got hold of the PDA of the legendary founder of "Duty" - and guess what?It turns out that he deceived his fighters into believing that the command abandoned them in the Zone, and on this topic he formed the current group!But in the Zone, meanness does not go in vain: soon this handsome man ended up in a spatial bubble - and hoo-hoo to the next world!So... And I, a fool, was still thinking about joining «Duty»!No, let the robots march without me...

New "Duty" squad.They appeared as if out of thin air!Think about it: a group of «Dolgovites» leaves «Yanov», and when they return there are almost three times as many of them!Are they dabbling in cloning?.. Although, you know, I wouldn't be surprised if that's the case: what will happen to the «Dolgovites»!After all, they probably only differentiate each other by rank.

New "Freedom" squad.They appeared as if out of thin air!Just think: a group of «Svobodovites» leaves «Yanov», and when they return there are almost three times as many of them!Well, they don't reproduce by budding?.. Although, in general, that's what will happen to the Svoboda members.The grass will sprout, take root - and let's, you know, reproduce vegetatively...

Do you know Gonta and his guys?They had a black streak for a long time: Danila disappeared, the Crab was wounded... But now there is a white streak: they got a job with the scientists, to take measurements for them.Tell me, are the guys happy?The work is probably dust-free, but if they're lucky, they'll also get official passes.

Do you know the stalker trio Mityai, Torba and Bear?As I heard, they got a job with scientists to take measurements.The devil knows what this work consists of, but it's unlikely that the university geniuses have come up with anything good.Okay, it's okay: the guys are in trouble, they'll break through - and then, lo and behold, they'll knock out official passes for themselves!

Have you heard about Spartak and his guys?Now you won't see them at Skadovsk - the scientists' bunker is guarded.And what?The guys know how to deal with mutants, and they have fought off bandits more than once.The matter is worthwhile in every sense: science needs peace, but the guys need status and money.

Maybe he saw mercenaries hanging around the substation workshops?That's it, they are not there.There are rumors that they went to Jupiter to guard the scientists' bunker.Before them, there also seemed to be mercenaries on guard, but something happened to them.In principle, this is not a bad trend: some are disappearing, others are leaving to take their place... Just like that two or three more times, and the mercenaries on Zaton will end for good.

According to eyewitnesses, the scientists' bunker is now guarded by the valiant «Duty» fighters.I wonder what benefit the «debt people» will get from this?Do they really hope that scientists will invent a plasma gun in gratitude to them to chase away jerboas?Oh, these defenders for me...

They say that the scientists' bunker is now guarded by «Svoboda»... I wonder if scientists are not afraid that their research specimens can easily be smoked?On the other hand, this is not without benefit: if someone wants to attack the bunker, they will first have to look for it in this smoke screen and at the same time not get lost in the centers.

Have you seen Jupiter, which is a radio equipment factory?Creepy place!Fuck knows what's happening there: the anomalies seem to be the same, and there are no more mutants than anywhere else... but I still don't want to go there.I can feel it in my gut that these places are crappy.

Listen, are you the guy who exposed the doctor at Skadovsk?Thank you for this!And then, you see, I could end up on his table over time... After all, it's true that everyone sinned against the creatures, but it turned out that there are worse people than a mutant.

So you should be asking what's new!After your trip to the tunnels under Jupiter, rumors spread that you had reached the center of the Zone, there was such a commotion... Ten people were already trying to follow you!Only Azot disappointed everyone, he said that the gates to the tunnels were closed and he would no longer be able to open them.There are, of course, desperate heads who want to blow up the door, but they have not yet figured out where to get so much dynamite and what they will breathe when they go down.

Oh, have you heard about Garik?The stalker who worked for the scientists.Now you can't call him an «unregistered person», he knocked out an official pass to the Zone, that's right!He should have taken the swag home from the Zone, but he took it and went to Pripyat!Well, you saw it, huh?.. They thought that was it, he disappeared like the others - but no, he did!True, this is of little benefit to the stalkers: he met the military there.He doesn't care now, he has a pass, and there's no reason for ordinary stalkers to go there.

Well... «Freedom» and «Duty» are at war again, they couldn't share some cache.They say there were countless weapons there, enough for three divisions!I don't know which of them hid so many weapons, but the showdown was not weak, it alarmed all the stalkers on the Yanov.It's good that they moved aside, otherwise it would have been like last time... Now the Svoboda members are on duty there - apparently, «Dolg» was unlucky.

Well... «Duty» and «Svoboda» are at war again, they couldn't share some cache.They say there were countless weapons there, enough for three divisions!I don't know which of them hid so many weapons, but the showdown was not weak, it alarmed all the stalkers on the Yanov.It's good that they moved aside, otherwise it would have been like last time... Now the «Dolgovts» are on duty there - apparently, «Svoboda» was unlucky.

Yes, it happened recently: a group of stalkers climbed into the tunnels near «Jupiter» and stumbled upon something - or rather, someone.First, the guys' machine guns were knocked out of their hands, and then all sorts of crap flew at them.In general, they themselves cannot really explain what happened there, although they lost two people there.

I heard that north of Jupiter, in the tunnels, some mutant crap was found.St. John's wort sent a stalker there to investigate.It turned out that there was a burer's lair there.You ask why in the past tense?But that stalker simply killed all the burers.And alone.Based on your description, you even look like him, only that guy is taller and always carries a grenade launcher with him.

Khan has come for the stalkers... The creatures have come from Plavnya.At the cement plant they saw how they dragged away a stalker.There are at least a dozen of them there - and all of them are hefty!They look like bloodsuckers, only twice as big and fast - fear!One hope now: St. John's wort.Maybe he knows how to deal with these monsters?

Have you already heard about swamp bloodsuckers?Well, those who were in Plavny?So, now they are not there.They say St. John's wort has figured it out.Not alone, though: he hired stalkers.They say that a detachment of about ten people gathered, they combed this swamp up and down, and everything that popped up was shot to hell.Now there is no frog left there.

Yes, they just started saying that they saw the chimera, and then someone immediately killed her.Apparently, stalkers are no longer so simple!Now the mutants who used to kill stalkers in batches are becoming expendable... Although, they say, he was an experienced hunter, he already has as many mutants on his account as there are dead mosquitoes between you and me.

Have you heard what kind of people Svoboda is recruiting to join its ranks?There was this one here - Flint, all the time weaving tales about his exploits, but it turned out - a scoundrel, of which there are few!He left his comrade in the anomaly to die, and he himself ran away for swag.And then his new «exploits» surfaced: for example, on Zaton he almost fed the hunters to a chimera... But before, I had a better attitude towards the «Svobodovites»... No, it's better to go alone than to have such friends!

Yes, they killed the chimera on Zaton: Gonta's group worked together with some stalker... Listen, it seemed like it was you, right?Well, then you can tell this story yourself - first-hand, so to speak.That's it... thank you!Still, life became a little calmer without the extra cannibal mutant.

New is not new, but there is such an uncle here, Noah drove him.In short, this guy has no tower at all, I answer!You're just staring at his barge: damn, this is a landscape from a single person on a covered barge!And that's not the whole joke!He, like, built it in a week... Gee, he's a blown migrant worker, crap!.. No, he's a complete moron: he makes fun, in short, of everyone who walks close.In short, screw it.

Do you know one of the stamps, he was fast?So he is naturally a nimble type.Not only does he carry real guns to order, but he also dips them - you'll find hell!No, tell me, where can I put the Vintar, so that it doesn't hang around anywhere?Really a magician, blah!

Shh!.. There is such a Maza, like the Sultan got a real bummer.Like the godfather wanted to crush the Beard under himself, but he took on too much... well, that's it, the bird waved its wing at him.Now the Sultan will be in trouble with the boys: the authority has not yet been exhausted, but it's not the same anymore.

Maza is that Sultan Beard was taken into circulation and has real money from his affairs.In short, everything is fine with Sultan, he is in good standing, but the most important topic is now different: it's time to establish our law at Skadovsk!.. So what?You want to jump in there from being thrown out - either live according to the rules, or go crazy, let's say.

Maine, have you heard about Oasis?Just imagine: a place that heals all wounds and illnesses!Eh, either this is some kind of trick, or a real miracle, or... there is one more thought.Have you noticed that recently the Granter of Desires has become somewhat silent, but Oasis is the one in the news?Maybe that Oasis is someone's wish fulfilled?

Here interesting information arrived from scientists: they rattled off an artifact straight from the Oasis!The coolest thing, however, is something else.There is a topic that with the results of studying this crap it will be possible to create an effective medicine against cancer... figured it out, right?!

There is nothing new, everything is the same.Now everyone remembers old stories about the center of the Zone, for example about the Oasis - a place where strength is restored and wounds heal instantly.It's nonsense, of course, but it's interesting to hear, especially about where it is located... Oh, if only such a place really existed!How many of our guys could have been saved!

They say that the Oasis has actually been found.I would never have thought that it existed, but you can't argue with the facts.There was some kind of special artifact inside, now scientists are picking at it.It seems that based on it they will be able to make a device for instant healing of wounds... a thing, whatever one may say, is useful in all respects.

Diggers!It's not new in the Zone, but it's still new to me.Just imagine: a whole village, with all its houses, buried up to the rooftops!The legacy of 1986: the houses are blazing - it's terrible!It's another place, yes.

Do you know the topic of how we ended up under the same roof on Yanov with the armored ones?Consider this to be the merit of Zulu - he was still in «Duty» at that time, and he was highly valued - he could smell emissions... We were the first to come to «Yanov», right after the stalkers.But we didn't even have time to light a cigarette, we look - the brakes are semi-army rods, they are waving their barrels!.. In general, the last time I saw this was at the Landfill, more than a year ago.Guys were killed on both sides - fear!Our smeller was put to death, blessed memory to him... And then Zulus screamed - throw out, they say, everyone hide!.. Well, what to do?You can't leave people behind the door to die, even «Dolgovtsev»?.. This is how we live now: when it's calm, we squabble little by little, and when the eruption hits, we sit next to each other quietly, like mice... And Zulu, by the way, left «Duty».Now he lives on his own next to «Yanov»...

Well, it's not news and it's no secret that the technician Cardan almost completely drank himself to death.But they say that when he first came to Skadovsk, he drank purely for decontamination and on rare holidays.It was then, later, that out of grief he began to put it behind his collar - his friends disappeared... Apparently, they really were good friends, since he went into such a tailspin.

Yes, there was a joke recently: a guy said in all seriousness that a UFO flew over Yanov.This is what the Zone brings people to, huh?Poltergeists with controllers are not enough - bring on UFOs!Glory to the Almighty, no one has signed up to be a psychic yet, and no one is trying to charge vodka.«Go away, unclean force, remain pure alcohol»...

Have you heard about the village of Kopachi?When there was the first accident at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, it was so covered in radiation that they decided to bury the entire village.Now all that remains of the houses in the village are radioactive mounds.They say the place was creepy back then, but no one really knows what's going on there now - they try not to wander in.

Not news anymore - but maybe you haven't heard.We are sitting here with Svoboda in an embrace not because we like it: circumstances forced us.When we arrived here, the Svoboda members immediately attacked us.We worked competently - although they, these stoners, put a lot of ours in, just a little more, and we would have done them!And then, in the midst of the battle, Zulu felt the approach of a release - and he is never mistaken... Well, in general, there was nowhere to go - we had to postpone the showdown with Svoboda.But I don't understand Zulu: why did he leave «Duty» after this mess?

Recently, our intelligence reported that an unidentified flying object passed over the Yanov station... yeah, a UFO!To avoid any stupid questions, I'll clarify right away: a UFO is not only a saucer with Martians, it's any flying crap - even a piece of plywood, even an atmospheric probe - that observers could not identify.

You're the one who brought that PDA to Loki, right?Damn, this is just a bomb!The legendary founder of "Dolg", General Tachenko, stupidly abandoned his fighters, broke the radio so that they could not be pulled out, put together a detachment of armored men from them and simply curled up in a spatial bubble.Complete alles kaput!..

Have you seen that the Dolgovites have a new squad?Obviously not reinforcements from the base: ideology has not yet emerged there instead of brains.They are trained too well - which means they are not recruited stalkers.The devil knows who they are... Should we believe the rumors that these are former «Monoliths»?Yes, this is a rut, pure rut.

Have you seen our new fighters?.. Oh, so you brought them, right?Pass!They're cool dudes, just a little uptight... Well, it's okay - they'll hang out with us for six months, free their minds, get into our topics - they'll be on board!

We have a new addition, and what a one: a detachment of former «Monolithians»!Not beginners without training, but real fighters.Of course, after «Monolith» their brains have not yet completely settled into place, but this can be fixed: our priest... that is, the deputy commander for educational and psychological work - he will take care of them.

They say that «Svoboda» has recruited former «Monoliths» into its ranks.Nonsense, rumors?But come on: they really did have a new detachment, and it clearly did not come from the borders of the Zone.Probably, things are really bad for Svoboda, or maybe the drugs have completely knocked out their brains... Who will they take on next - a squad of zombies?A platoon of bureaucrats?

Soon order will be restored in this territory: «Duty» has taken key positions in the area.We have a good foothold on Yanov, and now we have round-the-clock security near the scientists' bunker.It's time for «Svoboda» to pack up its belongings and get out of here.There is no place for anarchists in the Zone!

A new wonder of the world - a sober Cardan!He doesn't drink at all, can you imagine?The guys at Skadovsk asked him where he found such an effective psychic, but he just laughed it off: they say, the squirrel coded it with some sixty-second code.

You remember, you got our dudes to work as security guards for scientists?Special thanks to you for that!.. Do you know how nice it was to turn to the scientists' bunker and see our people there instead of the scoundrel mercenaries?So positive, what are you talking about!..

What's new is a lot of fun from the tasty treats from the «Dolg» stash.Now we will use it for its intended purpose: to imprison the «Dolgovtsev» prisoners so that they can tell their secrets, hehe... Yes, and thanks also for telling ours about the signaling!Without reinforcements we would have fought back.

Another victory for "Duty"!The anarchists became completely insolent - and they paid for their arrogance.They climbed into our secret warehouse and decided that they could get away with it... But as if not so!We covered them and shot them all like rabid jerboas!

It's no longer news that there are only scumbags in Svoboda, only here some details of the biography of one of these unfinished Chegevars were revealed.Cadre in «Freedom» was called Flint, but before that he was known as the stalker Soroka.Under this nickname he appeared on Zaton and almost killed a group of mutant hunters - he simply set them up.As a result, the guys were almost torn apart by the chimera, and this bastard grabbed their equipment and came here to the Yanov.As soon as he put on his Svoboda uniform, he immediately pulled off a new trick: he threw his partner into an anomaly to take the artifact from him.This is how it is, «Freedom» in action.

Noah's new building!There is such a long-standing Zatonov attraction - a stalker named Noah.The guy is experienced, purposeful and at the same time absolutely touched.His latest fixed idea is to save all the stalkers from the imminent apocalypse, so he is trying to build an ark from an old barge... As for me, this is a one-man show called «Madhouse».If you decide to look there, most importantly, don't bother Noah.He's touched, yes, but generally quite harmless.

Haven't met Shustroy?He is now at Skadovsk.You can't say anything about someone who is an expert in his field!He can get - well, almost anything.True, lately he has only been carrying guns and protection, but what kind!New items, experimental developments, handmade products... although he has prices to match.On the other hand, what complaints can there be?This is exclusive!

Do you know that Pilot is now leading a new route between Zaton and Jupiter?Previously, you had to walk for a long time and everything was uphill, and you had to zigzag between anomalies.And now - beauty!Not a hike, but a walk in the park, and it takes half as much time.The pilot, however, honestly says that it was not he who found the route, but the stalker alone showed him his maps.Not for free, of course, but in good conscience, I didn't break the price.
Nothing special.
Yes, in the Zone, wherever you turn there is something new!
You just showed up.Consider it news too.
What's new in the Zone?
I don't know anything else interesting.
I would tell you, but I didn't hear anything else interesting.
What he knew, he told.

Hmmm... I think you should ask Capercaillie at Skadovsk.He was looking for help in one complicated case: where stalkers disappear, and no one knows how or where.They talk and find them completely drained of blood, which is why the rumor started that bloodsuckers were to blame.But when would creatures commit such atrocities?.. Almost every other day someone disappears, and this doesn't look like ordinary bloodsuckers.The capercaillie even hired an experienced hunter to track down where exactly they were coming from.

You know, when a stalker needs money, he has two options: either look for artifacts and sell them to traders for a third of the real price, or go to scientists to work.Scientists will always come up with some kind of work for the stalker: they need a rare artifact, they need to deliver a mutant carcass, or something else.But the most important thing: if you come to an agreement with the scientists, they can issue you a pass to the Zone.Official!Just imagine: you walk past the military at the Cordon with a backpack full of swag, and they just don't salute you.Beauty!.. So, next to the Yanov station, a little from it to the west, the scientists' bunker was dumped.They already have one stalker working for sure - so maybe there will be a job for you too.

Just don't rush to shoot the first pseudo-dog that comes along and run for the reward!He issues tasks for specific monsters that interfere with the hauling of swag - or for those that have settled near the places where stalkers wait out emissions.

Well, if you need a babos specifically, go to Sych.At Skadovsk he sells what a real guy needs - information and guns.If something interesting fell into your pocket - documents there, shmokumenty, or some thread of a stalker's PDA, you take it to him, you will get a good deal.Well, in short, there's always a reason to ask him: he charges double for his personal orders.

Maybe you should ask Gonta?With his group, this story came out the other day... In general, recently a chimera appeared on Zaton, and after it came Gonta and with him his guys - hunters, that means.Well, they began to track down this creature.They were tracking, that means, and then the group split up: one guy was urgently sent to find the bloodsuckers' lair.And it turned out that when they spotted the chimera, they didn't have enough people, so they took one stalker with them, there was one named Soroka... I don't know exactly what happened there - they only say that Soroka, who went with them, ran away as soon as he saw the chimera.But Gonta and his guys barely fought back; one was seriously caught by the creature.So now they desperately need experienced people: after all, the chimera is still prowling around the neighborhood.
Here, in short, the situation is simple: if you want to earn money normally, go to the Sultan.He is in authority here, so if you are a smart guy, he will quickly find you a job.

Well, if you are a smart stalker and know how to look for artifacts, go to Beard, everyone here respects him.He is the only one at Skadovsk who buys artifacts at a normal price.They say he has connections to smuggle them beyond the perimeter of the Zone.And he is a good person: he can help with advice and offer profitable work.

There is a merchant at Skadovsk, they call him Sych... I must say, not a particularly pleasant guy.He constantly whines that the artifacts are not being brought to him, but to Beard.But if you urgently need money, you can contact him... This guy is slippery, he doesn't only sell ammunition and knows a lot of things.So if there is money, but no information, it goes back to him.And he lives on the second deck, in the stern.

You can ask Vano: he always hangs out near the bar at Yanov.I ended up on the counter of the bandits, this is the third time I've been paying them back, but it still won't be closed... It seems like an experienced stalker, he can pass through any anomaly with his eyes closed, but he just constantly gets into some kind of trouble.He has already been offered many times to go further away: The zone is large, if you don't want to, they won't find him... He is proud, refuses to run, and, of course, no one is particularly keen to help him deal with the bandits.

What kind of work is there... The bandits have gone completely crazy - they took Mityai prisoner and are demanding a ransom.But Mityai was one of the first stalkers to come to «Yanov», arranged everything here so that he could hide from the ejection - and now, it turns out, there is no one to save him.«Freedom» and «Duty» have no time to sort this out: they, as usual, want to rip each other's throats out, but the rest... But what can we say if Mityai's group themselves cannot decide how to free him!If you suddenly want to help them, find the Bear - he was at the station near the bar.

Azot, a technician on the Yanov, was just asking who could get him the materials.He's not only a weapons specialist, he's also a wow expert in electronics!Only knowledge is not enough, and he doesn't have any materials, so he asks everyone... The main problem is this: in safe places everything has long been stolen, but no one wants to go into dangerous ones for all sorts of nonsense.Azoth said that if they bring something suitable, he will not be in debt.
